mapper.sql: id, user_id, article_id, parent_id, reply_to_user_id, content, like_count, status, deleted, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments (user_id, article_id, parent_id, reply_to_user_id, content, like_count, status, deleted, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{articleId}, #{parentId}, #{replyToUserId}, #{content}, #{likeCount}, #{status}, #{deleted}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE comments SET like_count = like_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE comments SET like_count = CASE WHEN like_count > 0 THEN like_count - 1 ELSE 0 END WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
